description: This file contains source code for Orleans Memory Grain Storage, including options, validators, extensions for building storage in silos, and classes implementing grain storage interfaces, with additional classes supporting latency simulation.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for in-memory grain storage, including serializer settings and initialization parameters.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration options for in-memory grain storage.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements in-memory grain storage operations with methods to read, write, and clear grain state.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing method to create instances of MemoryGrainStorage.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency
classes.description: A variation of in-memory grain storage that adds latency simulation capabilities.

classes.name: MemoryStorageWithLatencyOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring latency behavior in MemoryGrainStorageWithLatency.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for adding and configuring in-memory grain storage within an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddMemoryGrainStorage
methods.description: Extension methods to add memory grain storage to the silo builder, with optional configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of MemoryGrainStorage for a given service provider and name.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state of a specified grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a specified grain asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state of a specified grain asynchronously.
